# Mateo Pavoni

> Full Stack Developer based in Córdoba, Argentina, building end-to-end web and mobile products with Next.js, Supabase, and automation tooling (n8n). Portfolio site: single-page, bilingual (Spanish/English).

Since September 2026 Mateo works as a Junior Full Stack Developer at AR IT Services (on-site in Córdoba, Scrum team, React, .NET and Supabase), and keeps taking on freelance projects. Previously he was a .NET trainee developer at Encode S.A. and shipped production sites and internal tools for small businesses (barbershops, training academies, crane rental, nutrition/health clinics) as well as personal engineering projects exploring distributed systems, workflow engines, and chaos engineering.

## Site

- [Portfolio (Spanish, default)](https://mateopavoni.com.ar/es): About, tech stack, projects, work experience, contact form.
- [Portfolio (English)](https://mateopavoni.com.ar/en): Same content, translated.
- [Resume/CV](https://mateopavoni.com.ar/cv.pdf): PDF resume.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Svelte, Sass, Bootstrap.
- Backend: Node.js, Go, FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot, Elixir/Phoenix, Supabase, .NET Core, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis.
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, Zustand.
- Infra: Docker, Cloudflare, Linux, Coolify, Dokku, Vercel.
- Automation/AI: n8n, Meta API, Google Cloud, Claude, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Grok.

## Projects

- [Marcovich Barbería](https://marcovichbarber.com.ar/): Booking platform for a premium barbershop — Next.js, Supabase, WhatsApp automation via n8n.
- [CodeTlon](https://codetlon.com): Institutional site for CodeTlon, an autonomous software factory — Next.js, Resend, GA4.
- [GC² Entrenamiento](https://gc2entrenamientoderesistencia.com.ar): Public site + CMS dashboard for a running/duathlon/triathlon coaching business — Next.js 16, Supabase.
- [Grúas InGlobal](https://gruasinglobal.com): Institutional site for a crane rental company, rewritten from legacy PHP to Next.js with a CMS dashboard.
- [TV Pro Academy](https://tvproacademy.com.ar): Site + admin dashboard for a one-on-one football training academy — Next.js, Supabase.
- [Vimet](https://vimetsalud.com.ar): Nutrition/training clinic system migrated from legacy PHP/MySQL to Next.js 16 and Supabase, with clinical records, PDF plans, and Row Level Security.
- [ChronoFlow](https://chronoflow.mateopavoni.com.ar): DAG-based workflow engine with async parallelism and Time-Travel Debugging — FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, React Flow, WebSockets.
- [TuTienda](https://tutienda.mateopavoni.com.ar): Multi-store e-commerce SaaS with no-oversell guarantees under concurrency — Go microservices, MongoDB, Redis, SvelteKit.
- [Chaos Playground](https://chaos-playground.mateopavoni.com.ar/): Chaos Engineering playground where each canvas node is a real Erlang/OTP GenServer — Elixir, Phoenix LiveView.
- [ClubCore](https://clubcore-api.mateopavoni.com.ar/swagger-ui.html): REST API for managing a health/sports club, with concurrency-safe booking and resilient webhooks — Java, Spring Boot, Resilience4j.
